missing_sponsorship_language.interpretation: Employer may support transfer; no confirmation either way.

principles.sponsorship_claims: Require dated evidence for CONFIRMED, LIKELY or UNAVAILABLE. Historical support does not confirm this role. Ambiguous no-sponsorship wording must not be silently equated to an explicit refusal of the needed transfer.
principles.location: Apply allowed countries and arrangements; preferred cities improve priority without excluding other allowed locations.
principles.role_content: Evaluate responsibilities and evidence rather than title alone. Distinguish product prototyping and technical collaboration from a core software-engineering job.
principles.seniority: Compare scope and ownership, using personal level preferences; title mismatch alone is not a hard gate.
principles.investor_backing: Optional priority signal requiring sourced company-specific evidence. Examples in personal context are not an allowlist. Unknown backing is not a disqualifier and does not alter capability scores.
principles.success: Explain evidence supporting interview competitiveness, offer competitiveness and ability to perform the work; do not invent probabilities or guarantee outcomes.
principles.human_review: Present recommendation, rationale, uncertainties and what would change it; user chooses pursuit level.

decision_rules.skip: Only a sourced incompatibility with an explicit profile constraint; never missing career evidence alone.

calibration: Initial explainable product defaults. Review against real user decisions before claiming predictive validity.
